q: What carbon data do global brands ask Penang electronics manufacturing suppliers for?
title: Penang EMS: brand carbon requests
short: Usually Scope 1 and 2 by site with year and method, renewable share, a target, and increasingly a product footprint for the assemblies you build. Build them from electricity and gas bills, refrigerant logs and component supplier data, and answer every portal with the same numbers.
audience: Electronics manufacturing services and component suppliers in Penang and Kulim serving computing, medical and automotive brands

ul: Renewable electricity share and how it is sourced.
Product footprint per board or assembly.

p: Components, especially chips and PCBs, carry most of an assembly's footprint. Your own SMT and test energy is small but must be shown with its split.
Use one data set for all customers and update it yearly. Different numbers in different portals are the quickest way to lose trust.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity, fuel and refrigerant invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record per site, so the figures a brand asks for trace back to the bills behind them.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
